notes: Fieldline Dispatch Desk: a self-contained facilities dispatch app with a Kanban board, jobs register (search/filter/sort/saved views/bulk actions), sites, crew capacity, and parts inventory sharing one localStorage state with guarded persistence, undo (30 steps), JSON import/export round-trip, CSV export, command palette (Ctrl+K), drag-and-drop plus keyboard flows, sample data, and empty/error/recovery states. Single index.html, no build step, works from file:// and subfolders. Browser-tested via local server: cold load with no console errors, board/jobs/sites/crew/parts render, drawer edit persisted across reload, illegal status moves and over-capacity assignments rejected, import/export wired.
